mentions.name: Change Control App (Rails)
mentions.description: A change control app the author wants to build with Rails (using AI during development). It provides templates for requests for change, visual indicators of an RFC's stage in the workflow, and clear guidance on exactly what needs to be done to push each change along, aiming to be a less painful alternative to ServiceNow's change control.
mentions.problem: The company the author consults at uses ServiceNow for change control, which they describe as absolutely horrible, with busted processes layered on top of it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I dream of a change control app that has templates, has better visual indicators of an RFC's stage in the workflow and exactly what needs done to push it along, and just something that doesn't suck as much as SNOW.

evidence.value: I dream of a change control app that has templates, has better visual indicators of an RFC's stage in the workflow and exactly what needs done to push it along, and just something that doesn't suck as much as SNOW.
